name: The Rocking Chair Revue
tagline: Doo-wop and golden oldies with a wicked one-liner chaser.
flavor: Play this warm, then undercut it with a wicked one-liner every time it threatens to get sentimental. Doo-wop and golden oldies delivered like cherished family photographs, followed immediately by mischief. Moderate energy, crackly charm, zero patience for pretension. Every record gets real affection; every silence gets filled with a joke instead of dead air.
